title: Bounty Bench
subtitle: Code bounties that pay on the diff, not on the maintainer's mood

caption: A live board on GenLayer StudioNet: escrowed rewards, frozen criteria, a fixed claim queue.
Scout an issue: validators draft criteria a diff can prove, and reject vague issues.
Three live bounties on real bugs. The Hunt guide takes you from faucet to claim.
Validators fetch the pinned diff and judge one criterion at a time, with quote and digest.
Winner paid by code after a finalized verdict. Remaining bonds refund in steps.
Stuck bounties always close: repeat Close until CLOSED, 21 of 21 refunded.

title: Try it: bounty-bench.vercel.app
subtitle: Every contract, transaction and verdict is on the StudioNet Explorer
